title: MambaCSP: Hybrid-Attention State Space Models for Hardware-Efficient Channel State Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2604.21957v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent works have demonstrated that attention-based transformer and large language model (LLM) architectures can achieve strong channel state prediction (CSP) performance by capturing long-range temporal dependencies across channel state information (CSI) sequences. However, these models suffer from quadratic scaling in sequence length, leading to substantial computational cost, memory consumption, and inference latency, which limits their applicability in real-time and resource-constrained wireless deployments. In this paper, we investigate whether selective state space models (SSMs) can serve as a hardware-efficient alternative for CSI prediction. We propose MambaCSP, a hybrid-attention SSM architecture that replaces LLM-based prediction backbones with a linear-time Mamba model. translated_title: MambaCSP：面向硬件高效信道状态预测的混合注意力状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：近期研究表明，基于注意力的Transformer和大语言模型（LLM）架构通过捕捉信道状态信息（CSI）序列中的长程时间依赖性，能够实现强大的信道状态预测（CSP）性能。然而，这些模型在序列长度上存在二次方扩展的问题，导致计算成本、内存消耗和推理延迟显著增加，限制了其在实时和资源受限的无线部署中的应用。本文探讨了选择性状态空间模型（SSMs）是否可以作为CSI预测的硬件高效替代方案。我们提出了MambaCSP，一种混合注意力SSM架构，用线性时间的Mamba模型替代基于LLM的预测骨干网络。为了克服纯SSM仅能捕捉局部依赖性的局限，我们引入了轻量级的补丁混合注意力层，定期注入跨令牌注意力。
tldr: 本文提出MambaCSP，一种混合注意力状态空间模型，用线性时间Mamba替代LLM骨干，并结合轻量级补丁混合注意力层，实现硬件高效且性能优越的信道状态预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MambaCSP, a hybrid-attention state space model that replaces LLM backbones with linear-time Mamba and integrates lightweight patch-mixer attention layers, achieving hardware-efficient and strong channel state prediction.
